    Finite ray categories and their irreducible path relation #

    Record the source-level axioms of a finite ray category and construct the quiver whose reversed arrows are irreducible morphisms. Parallel paths are related when they evaluate to the same nonzero ray morphism. This relation is the combinatorial contour relation used in the BGRS tackle argument; it is not identified here with scalar proportionality in a linear realization.

        class LargeIndecomposable.IsFiniteRayCategory (C : Type u) [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms C] :
        Prop

        Source-faithful finite form of the ray-category axioms in BGRS 1.7.

        Finiteness of the object type is kept as a separate Finite C assumption, since several abstract lemmas only need the local axioms below.

        • id_ne_zero (X : C) : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id X ≠ 0
        • hom_finite (X Y : C) : Finite (X ⟶ Y)
        • endomorphism_nilpotent {X : C} (f : CategoryTheory.End X) : f ≠ CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id X → ∃ (n : ℕ), 0 < n ∧ f ^ n = 0
        • skeletal {X Y : C} : Nonempty (X ≅ Y) → X = Y
        • factorization_comparable {X Y : C} (f g : X ⟶ Y) : TwoSidedEndomorphismFactors f g ∨ TwoSidedEndomorphismFactors g f
        • source_stabilizer_trivial {X Y Z : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (a : CategoryTheory.End X) : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f g ≠ 0 → CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a f) g = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f g → a = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id X
